text: かえって　きて　おったのか　ポケモンずかんは　どのくらい　あつまったのか　みせて　くれんか？

structure.jp: かえって　きて　おったのか
ポケモンずかんは　どのくらい　あつまったのか
structure.en: how much of the Pokédex has been gathered

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる means someone does the action as a favor to the speaker. くれん is the old-man form of くれない, so asking with か makes a request. みせて　くれんか = 'won't you show me?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: おった is the old-man form of いた, so this is ていた: the state after something happened. きて　おった = 'had come and were here'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb shows the action moves toward where the speaker is. かえって　きて = 'coming back here'.
